verdict: Task sequence failed in `Install Software Updates`. A specific update requested a second reboot that the TS controller did not orchestrate. CBS / servicing-stack updates that dual-restart are the usual culprit.
fix: Do not install SSUs or servicing-stack updates through OSD. Install them via regular software updates before the TS runs, or split them into their own deployment outside the TS. Known dual-restart updates: `KB3126446`, `KB3096053`, any monthly SSU. Add the KBs to an exclusion list on the TS `Install Software Updates` step; install them separately from the OSD flow.
